integrity: The claimed formula is proved analytically from the published absolute-norm comparison bound, an exact computation of the two comparison ratios, and explicit unit-sphere extremizers on both parameter branches; finite numerical stress tests are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the real two-dimensional Lorentz space at \(r=1\) and to the quadratic Gao constant. It does not settle \(1<r<2\) or other Gao-type exponents, and literature searches cannot exclude an unindexed alias.
title: Exact Gao constant at the polyhedral Lorentz endpoint
